items.q: both times with the participation of the Abbey de Fatto, who was an ex-jazz musician.

ctx.x: But it was less fun when we came back to Paris where bad news was waiting for us. We had met two years previously a woman who was in the real estate business. She seemed to be a smart business woman and was quite a nice person. We had confidence in her ability, and had invested our savings in her housing construction company. But the company went bankrupt and we lost every penny that we had saved for years without any hope of getting our money back. It was no use to cry over spilled milk, but it was a bitter…

I had been approached by a French musician named Jeff Gilson. Jeff was a pianist and arranger. He was quite talented as an arranger, and we were going to work quite a bit together. First he had formed a big orchestra, and we gave a concert at the Theatre de l'est Parisien. Then we gave two concerts of sacred music in two churches in Paris. One in the church"St.Etienne du Mont" and the other one in "St.Jean de Belleville", both times with the participation of the Abbey de Fatto, who was an ex-jazz musician. I had…

We gave other concerts with a small formation with Jeff's rhythm section, and the alto sax Hubert Fol, at the O.R.T.F. theatre, and for some cultural centres in France. Jeff asked me to record an album called 'Jazz Dor God'. I played two numbers: "Jericho" and "Sometimes I feel like a motherless child".
